اقتفيت (form VIII)
# اِقْتَفَيْتُ (iqtafaytu) /iq.ta.faj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
# اِقْتَفَيْتَ (iqtafayta) /iq.ta.faj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
# اِقْتَفَيْتِ (iqtafayti) /iq.ta.faj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
# اُقْتُفِيتُ (uqtufītu) /uq.tu.fiː.tu/: first-person singular
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
